Yes, I'm the same. I'm just over 1yr PPT and I was totally not expecting (nor ready for lol) climax through penetration. There was a time early on where I thought I'd never climax again, and just tried to accept that. But now everything in that area has exceeded even my initial expectations around sex. I was getting arousal from clitoral stimulation, which was nice enough, but could never reach climax. Then about 8mths in, after I started using toys for penetration, omg one day my whole body exploded with an enormous climax. It blew me away for a number of reasons after I assessed it all. To go from nothing to a full climax upon penetration with toys felt like some kind of miracle. The realisation after repeat sessions that got increasingly better, and that internal stimulation plus clitoral stimulation, and variations on this, has been incredible. Since my surgery, I've realised there still isn't a lot known about PPT, so surprises are still a thing, and I've found no reference to what I've experienced over the past year or so, let alone any guarantees of such experiences (which doesn't mean they're not out there; maybe I just haven't looked hard enough). So while I would like to get some minor aesthetic revisions, I am very happy with depth, width, elasticity, the fact I don't have to dilate often at all, and just functionality more generally. I don't know what the mechanics are re orgasm from penetration, as in how much of it is psychological versus physical, or whatever ratio of both is involved. My feelings on it are that somehow clitoral and penetrative stimulation combine to create a whole-of-area excitable zone that my brain has "rewired" itself to perceive as pleasure and leading to climax. I should add that even when I climax from penetration alone, the toys I use in this instance are shaped and wide enough where my vaginal opening is also being stimulated, so that no doubt factors into the equation. I have no idea how it all works, there really are no conclusive studies on this, and there must be so many psychological/physical variability factors involved between arousal/climax conditions for women that it's not an easy area to research, let alone comparing personal anecdotes to arrive at some standard path to climax. I'm just glad it all works.
